title: Reset Ethernet link speed
summary: Restart the Ethernet adapter to fix speed downshift issues (e.g., stuck at 100Mbps instead of 1Gbps).

steps.explain: Bring the interface down to reset the link negotiation.
steps.cmd: sudo ip link set dev <INTERFACE> down

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the Ethernet interface.

steps.explain: Bring the interface back up to renegotiate the link speed.
steps.cmd: sudo ip link set dev <INTERFACE> up

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the Ethernet interface.

rollback.explain: If the link fails to come up, try rebooting the system.

warnings: This will temporarily disconnect you from the network.
